newsitem.title: USA: Insured Municipal Q2 income share flat.
newsitem.headline: Insured Municipal Q2 income share flat.

text.p: Insured Municipal Income Fund Inc said on Friday that earnings from the net investment income after preferred dividends were $4,098,439, or $0.20 a common share, for the second quarter ended September 30, 1996.
Net realized and unrealized gains were $5,970,228, equal to $0.29 per common share for the same period.
This compares with net investment income of $4,046,691, or $0.20 a share, and net realized and unrealized gains of $6,949,558, or $0.34 a share, the previous second quarter.

For the six month period, earnings from net investment income after preferred dividends were $8,219,435, or $0.40 a share, with total net realized and unrealized gains of $5,107,989, or $0.24 a share.
This compares with net investment income of $7,859,828 or $0.38 a share, and net realized and unrealized gains of $9,910,482, or $0.48 a share, in the comparable year-ago period.
